changelog: The lower Overview now shows named external trunks instead of treating internal SBC/IP Directory labels as clients or providers.
Inbound and outbound views follow the observed carrier leg; explicitly internal/on-net trunks are excluded from commercial rows.
changelog_es: The lower Overview is now external-trunk centric: internal SBC endpoints from IP Directory never appear as commercial rows.
External traffic is grouped by configured trunk name and its observed inbound or outbound leg; explicitly internal trunks are excluded.
Ambiguous and unattributed traffic remains visible as a catalog gap instead of being mislabeled as an internal IP or silently hidden.
